segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling the Bank of Ottawa.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: My name is Joao, customer support analyst.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: My name is Dorothy Brown and I currently have a credit card with your bank.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Would it be possible for me to open a checking account that I could link to this card or I suppose you have to look up and see if my information is there at all?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So let's start with that.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I just need your date of birth.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Can I get your date of birth?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: All right here's my card number, 760 -132 -598.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I also just need your date of birth to be able to confirm with our security, please.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, 2856.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I see you have an account with us under the credit card, and you're looking to open up a new checking account.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We can definitely help you with that today.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: First of all, how does that work?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Would it, if I use the credit card, could I make it go to the checking account or do I have to have two cards or do I have to have a different number?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: How does that work?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: How do you link it up?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Well, basically what we're going to do is that we're going to open up a new checking account, which that allows you to draw money from it.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The card that you currently have is just a credit card.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: This new checking account will be able to be linked to the credit card, meaning that you're able to make payments from your checking account to your credit card.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: But it will have another card itself because it's going to be a debit.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It's going to have a debit card.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So you're going to have two cards.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: But with the checking account, you will be able to pay your credit card much quicker and be able to show up and have that available credit a lot faster than you would normally.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So can I use this new card, this new checking account at the machines in the stores or no?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, so the way that a checking account works in a debit account, the way that it works is that it draws money only that you have.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It doesn't have any credit options unless you're using it for online purchases.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: This one is a debit credit card, but only in the sense of online purchases.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So it still only takes money from your account that you currently have available.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It does not take any money that you don't already have.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That's good to know because I'm trying to cut down on my expenses and I realize that a credit card is necessary because when you go to a hotel or some other places, they only take credit.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I don't think that that's right but is that true?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Well, I can't speak for all the hotels or different things like that.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: But from my own experience, a lot of times they do require credit cards specifically to be able to make security deposits or things of such of that nature.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So without that ability, it becomes very hard to be able to travel or anything else using a hotel.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: There are options such as Airbnbs, which don't require a credit card to be able to make a purchase for a stay.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, another interesting point that I was trying to figure out is, is there a monthly maintenance fee on this card, this checking account card or is the maintenance fee on the credit card?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: No, you're actually...

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: How do I pay them?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yeah, so for the credit card, there is an annual fee that we do offer that you already had available.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: In terms of the checking account, you're actually in luck.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: There is no annual fee with our card or even a monthly fee.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We are a no fees bank, which means that you don't have to pay anything for maintaining your balance with us or your account with us.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So it's a feature that we offer that the majority of banks don't offer.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So it gives you the freedom to know that banking with us doesn't cost you money.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, so what kind of security do you have in this account?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So if I was to do it online banking or on my phone banking, what type of security do you have for this account?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yeah, so our online banking and our mobile apps that we offer, which you can use directly from your smartphone, all have one of the top line security features that we offer, that the industry offers.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We offer what's known as two -factor authentication, which means it goes through two steps before you can get into your account.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It is a little bit sometimes a little bit more daunting for people, but it gives you that extra piece of mind to know that your account is not hacked.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: If you lose your card, we do offer a zero liability.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: If things are purchased with your card that was not you and you report it, we'll automatically reverse those charges on your card.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, so do I have to set up a PIN for this account like I do with my other things or can I withdraw from an ATM?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yeah, so you will have to set up usually a four to six digit pin to be able to access or to make purchases.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: If you use tap on your card, which is a feature that allows you to just tap the card, that does have a limit of $250, but that way you won't have to use a pin.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We also do have a daily withdrawal limit or purchase limit normally put in place of $1 ,000.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So in case you do have to make any purchases that are a little bit higher or you'd like that limit removed, those are automatic.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You can get those changed when you get the card and to just give us a call and say that you'd like those features removed.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Or if you make a big purchase, just give us a call and we'll up the limit temporarily for the purchase that you're trying to do.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: For the ATM access, you do have that access to be able to access at any of our locations.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: No charge to be able to access the ATM and your funds.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: However, if you do go to other banks, you can use their ATMs.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: However, there's usually a small conversion charge. Oh

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, so how do you have a machine in many places for your particular company or are you limited to a certain area?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: no, we're nationwide branches.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We have branches in many locations, over 300 branches in many small rural communities, as well as in all the major cities across Canada.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We are a very large but very family -friendly bank.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So you can trust us.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, so could you try and set it up right now and while I wait or do I need to wait for you to call me back?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Is this a long process?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Oh no, this is not a long process at all since we already have many of your information on file from the credit card.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Please give me a few minutes to be able to enter all the information in, and I will email you directly with all the other information.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You'll receive the new card in the mail within seven to ten business days.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And from there, it will give you further instructions on how to complete the setup and fully activate the card once you get it.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You'll have to create a pin, which all the instructions will be done there, and will be in the envelope once you receive your card.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, I think I'd like to go ahead with it then and setting up the new checking account.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That's great for you to hear.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: In case you're also wondering, we do also offer a savings promotion right now for a savings account.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Savings accounts are not normally used for purchases, but you can get free interest on your money that you deposit in, so that's free money for you.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So if you're interested, we do offer that option as well.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'll send the information via email to you in case you change your mind.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, I think I'd like to go ahead with that as well.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'm very glad to hear that.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So give me a few minutes here.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, I've entered the information and got you all started, so I'll be emailing you at the email that you've provided, and welcome aboard with our checking and savings accounts.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We're glad to have your business.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Well, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: It's been a pleasure talking with you.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You're very welcome.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'm Bank of Ottawa, and have a great day.
